context:
Goal: run the Duo and iPhone 18 Pro UI tests in CI, so the Duo work can merge with no Mac.
Problem (goal): the job needs a home. Your item 54 b says the tests run in CI, but not where the workflow file lives.
Based on (read): GitHub's xcode-27 macOS runner has the Duo and 18 Pro simulators; macos-26 has neither (PR 246, premise P3).
Based on (read): plan cloud-lane-cut lists the shared phone workflow in claude-settings (you paste it) as gated, with no lane yet.
Based on (ruling): owner, 2026-11-08 16:50 CST: no simulators on the Mac. CI is the only place these tests run.
Departs from: main .github/workflows — adds a macOS job that runs the Duo and 18 Pro UI test classes on xcode-27.
holds: Lane duo-ci-path, and the five Duo debts it retires, cannot start until this is answered.

options.gain: The lane starts now, with no paste from you.
options.how: Lane duo-ci-path adds a job under .github/workflows that runs on xcode-27. It can move to the shared workflow later.
options.label: A workflow file in this repo
options.lose: If the shared workflow lands later, this job moves once, in a second small lane.

options.gain: One home for phone CI across every repo.
options.how: You paste the shared reusable workflow into claude-settings; this repo calls it.
options.label: The shared phone workflow in claude-settings
options.lose: Lane duo-ci-path waits on your paste, and the Duo debts stay open until then.

ref: lane duo-ci-path in plan cloud-lane-cut (PR 249); item 54 duo-ui-tests-ci-path (you picked b, 15:23 CST); decision native-ci-on-hosted-macos (PR 246)
title: Where does the Duo CI job live: a workflow in this repo, or the shared phone workflow in claude-settings?
why: It unblocks wave 1 now; moving one job later costs less than holding the whole Duo line.
